title: Set bits, union, intersect and count
summary: Build two bit sets from lists of bit positions, then count each set, their union and their intersection.
notes: Cargo only: no npm or JSR package in this category, and no Python, Ruby, Go or JavaScript standard library ships a bit set. Each call builds both sets, forms the union and the intersection in fresh copies of the first set, and returns the four counts as a Rust array that is converted to JSON outside the timed call. Rust allocation-counting overhead is included in CPU figures. 36 fixtures are small and dense (up to 4,096 bits and 4,096 listed positions); 12 are large and sparse (65,536 to 1,000,000 bits, at most 512 listed positions) so that the union, intersection and counts over many words are measured as well as setting bits.
